human_review_text: This work explores invariance to symmetries in code that do not change the semantics of the code. This notion is formalized via automorphisms of program interpretation graphs. To achieve equivariance (and invariance) to these automorphisms, the authors use a self-attention based model with pairwise features based on an invariant distance matrix.
